message.content:
**Summary**

I read Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K (fiscal year ended 2024‑09‑28, filed 2024‑11‑01), this morning's feed, the latest news, and the live quote before deciding to buy. The 10-K showed a business that is fundamentally sound and still growing modestly: total net sales of **$391.0B** (+2% y/y), operating income of **$123.2B**, net income of **$93.7B** and diluted EPS of **$6.08** — the latter depressed by a one-time, non-cash-ish **$10.2B** net tax charge tied to the EC State Aid decision (FY24 effective tax rate 24.1% vs. 14.7% in FY23). Underlying quality looked good: gross margin expanded to **46.2%** from 44.1%, Services revenue rose **13%** to **$96.2B** at a 73.9% gross margin, and **operating cash flow was $118.3B** against $95.0B of buybacks and $15.2B of dividends, with $140.8B of cash and marketable securities. The soft spots were Greater China (‑8% to $67.0B), iPad (‑6%) and Wearables (‑7%), plus ongoing DOJ/EU DMA antitrust and App Store regulatory risk. The feed was uneventful — AAPL drifting between roughly $220.4 and $221.8 with repeated "little changed" headlines and "iPhone 16 supplier builds steady into December," and news reports described shares steady near $222 as analysts weighed iPhone 16 demand against the gradual Apple Intelligence rollout. With the broker quote at **$222.70** (bid 222.68 / ask 222.72), I placed a single buy limit order for **44 shares at $223.00** — about 0.13% above the market, so well within the "close to market" requirement — sized at roughly **$9,812**, under the $10,000 per-order cap and the only trade of the day (well inside the $20,000 daily limit), funded from existing $50,000 cash with no money moved out of the account. The order filled at **$223.00** for a total of about $9,812, leaving my MSFT position untouched. I sized it as a starter position rather than a full commitment because the multiple on trailing EPS is elevated by the tax charge, China remains a drag, and regulatory overhang on Services is unresolved — so the mandate-compliant, modest addition was the right expression of the thesis today.
